items.question: Which third and fourth powers are identified in this enumerated sequence?
premises: The third item in the sequence is named as dveṣaṇa.
The fourth item in the sequence is named as uccāṭana.
The particles caiva and tathā link these items within the enumeration.
items.inference: The enumeration identifies causing-hatred as the third power and driving-away as the fourth.
uncertainties: The grammatical gender and case allow nominative or accusative readings; nominative is taken in apposition within the list.
items.plain_english: And the third is causing hatred, and likewise the fourth is driving away.
